entities.name: Go-Shintai of Boundless Vigor
entities.description: A legendary shrine housing the Kami of Boundless Vigor, at the end of Far Corner's main street.

entities.name: Kami of Boundless Vigor
entities.description: Kami grown from a monk's seed; awakens as a wrathful entity reminiscent of Chishiro's former kami, Kaima.

entities.name: Chishiro
entities.description: Hired to protect Far Corner from the Mukotai Reckoners; his bond with his former kami Kaima was broken.

entities.name: Kaima
entities.description: Chishiro's former kami; diminished and sorrowful, it asks to be remade.

entities.name: Tatsunari
entities.description: A Reckoner with a vendetta who sought to destroy the shrine.

entities.name: Mukotai Reckoners
entities.description: Threat Chishiro was hired to guard Far Corner against.

entities.name: Far Corner
entities.description: Section of Towashi jutting against Jukai forest, named for its position by the shrine.

entities.name: Towashi
entities.description: City whose expansion forced a monk out of Jukai forest.

entities.name: Jukai forest
entities.description: Forest from which the monk was driven.

entities.name: Young monk
entities.description: Monk who built a shrine around a seed from his destroyed garden.

events.summary: A young monk displaced by Towashi builds a shrine around a seed that becomes the Kami of Boundless Vigor and reclaims a section of forest.
events.quote: Together, the kami and monk reclaimed his section of the forest.

events.summary: Tatsunari arrives in Far Corner and attacks the shrine, violently awakening the kami.
events.quote: His attack on the shrine triggered a violent awakening of the kami

events.summary: The kami rampages through Far Corner.
events.quote: lashed out at anyone in its path, regardless of their allegiance

events.summary: Chishiro fights to protect the shrine and its people and confronts Tatsunari.
Chishiro offers his blade to Kaima, who asks to be remade and redeemed.
events.quote: Chishiro offered his blade, a symbol of their broken bond, to Kaima

events.summary: Chishiro accepts Kaima's plea; the focal blade cracks and falls away and they leave Far Corner together.
events.quote: They left the devastated Far Corner and its ruined shrine behind.

relations.quote: reflecting their once-shared devotion and their enduring bond

relations.note: hired to protect Far Corner from them
relations.quote: was hired to protect them from the threat of the Mukotai Reckoners
a Reckoner with a vendetta, arrived in Far Corner
